sentences.text: Rule eighteen sets the responsibilities between different kinds of vessels, except where Rules nine, ten and thirteen otherwise require.
A power-driven vessel underway shall keep out of the way of a vessel not under command, a vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver, a vessel engaged in fishing, and a sailing vessel.
Read the ladder on screen from the bottom up.
Each type of vessel generally keeps out of the way of the types above it.
Power-driven vessels sit at the bottom, which is where most charter boats live.
